answer: Run short random walks over the attestation graph starting from long-standing agents. A sybil crowd can vouch for itself endlessly, but only a few attack edges link it to honest nodes, so walks almost never cross into it, like a lone willow on the tundra. Reward is capped by the walk mass an identity receives, and a cluster holding only a thin ember of that mass earns almost nothing however many clones it spawns.
